?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:144896
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 5957 of 2023

Applicant :- Chintu @ Mukesh Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Sharma

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.

2. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant Chintu @
Mukesh Singh in Case Crime No. 1139 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 306 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Kalyanpur, District Kanpur Nagar, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Police Station Kalyanpur, District Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has the apprehension of his arrest and has claimed parity with the co-accused Arvind Singh & Smt. Reena Singh, who have already been granted anticipatory bail by another Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application u/s 438 Cr.P.C. Nos. 3051 of 2023 & 5956 of 2023 vide orders dated 13.4.2023 & 03.07.2023.
Since the case of the applicant is at par with the co-accused who have already been granted anticipatory bail, the applicant is also entitled for the same on the ground of parity.

sentences.text: 4. The prayer for anticipatory bail has been vehemently opposed by learned AGA.
However, the aforesaid factual aspect of the parity to the co-accused has not been disputed by him.
5. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, the applicant is entitled to be granted anticipatory bail in this case.
6. In the this matter, it appears that the applicant is the brother-in-law (dewar) of the deceased.
No specific role has been assigned to him in the commission of the alleged crime.
There is no suicide note of the deceasedand in the post mortem report, it appears that the cause of death has been found suicidal hanging.

7. Without expressing any opinion upon ultimate merits of the case either ways which may adversely affect the trial of the case, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed on the ground of parity.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the anticipatory bail of the applicant.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of Chintu @ Mukesh Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108763281/
